entities.summary: GJ 1132 b is an exoplanet orbiting GJ 1132, a red dwarf star 41 light-years from Earth, in the constellation Vela. The planet is considered uninhabitable but was thought to be cool enough to possess an atmosphere. GJ 1132 b was discovered by the MEarth-South array in Chile.
